title: TAI owner activation command authority
objective: Provide a deterministic owner-only activation command that resolves and verifies the latest successful exact-main TAI Owner REG.RU Preflight run, while making skipped preflight workflow_run events neutral and non-mutating.
boundaries: The only issue command is /tai activate current-main on issue 3365
Commenter, actor and triggering actor must equal the repository owner
Activation requires an exact successful TAI Owner REG.RU Preflight run for current main
The upstream run must be an owner issue_comment run and all six required jobs must be successful
Skipped or unrelated preflight runs remain neutral and cannot publish activation failure
All image, REG.RU controller, live RU/EN/ZH, Chromium, rollback and deployment gates remain unchanged
